rules.content:
/*
nasirsecurity ransomware
*/

rule nasirsecurity_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.nasirsecurity"
        description = "Detects nasirsecurity ransomware ransom note or artifact"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $name1 = "nasirsecurity" ascii nocase
        $name2 = "NASIRSECURITY" ascii
        $onion  = "nasirsecurity.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
